stem: Which figure does NOT belong with the others?
hints: Each figure has two arrows. Compare the two arrows in each figure with each other.
In ↓↑, the arrows point in opposite directions: down and up.
Check whether the two arrows in each figure point in exactly opposite directions. Find the figure where they do not.

solution.methodName: Find the rule three of them share

steps.action: Check ↓↑: down and up are opposite directions.
Check ←→: left and right are opposite directions.
Check ↗↙: up-right and down-left are opposite directions.
steps.why: Opposite arrows lie on the same straight line and point away from each other, a half turn apart.

steps.action: Check ↖↗: up-left and up-right both point partly up. They are only a quarter turn apart, not opposite.
↖↗ breaks the rule. The answer is ↖↗.

trapNotes.↓↑: ↓↑ is the only upright pair, but every pair sits at a different angle. Its two arrows are opposite, like the others.
trapNotes.←→: ←→ is the only flat pair, but every pair sits at a different angle. Its arrows are opposite, so it follows the rule.
trapNotes.↗↙: ↗↙ is slanted, but so is ↖↗. Its arrows point exactly opposite ways, so it follows the rule.
